title: Backup MCP tools
observed_behavior: Before this slice, internal/mcp/server.go exposed services, deployments, ML, LLM, packages, workers, payments, policies, notifications, SBOMs, and tool provisioning, but no backup-specific MCP tools.
Backup domain, repository, registry handlers, operational handlers, and scheduler/placement services already existed outside internal/mcp.
intended_behavior: Agents can submit backup registry and operational intents through MCP as signer-first Nostr command requests rather than direct handler invocation or local polling.
Agents can list and inspect durable backup control-plane read models for repositories, policies, recipes, definitions, runs, restores, and retention runs.
MCP backup tools return correlation metadata for request event, result/status kinds, d tag, published relay count, and relevant resource identifiers.
